## History

Jerry Corcoran offered a political bribe to [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) near the Lake of [Shining Waters](../codex/places.md#shining-waters). Unbeknownst to Jerry, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally overheard the corrupt exchange. This covert transaction gave [Anne](../character/anne.md) the leverage she needed to pressure Judson into canceling a deal to rent his fences for patent medicine advertisements.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P2](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XIV. Anne’s Confession P3](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XIV.
